_doc: Every (kit table, cc, triton) TriMul launch-cell selection that had an admitted row in a kit's own fpf_trimul_v4 table through the previous per-kit loader (land_*), beside the ONE core table's selection for that kit's shape class (core_*). A kit table is identified by 'table' = the first 16 hex digits of the sha256 of its bytes (tables: its shape class, the cards it has rows for, its pinned-stack triton); the test finds the tree's kit tables by content. triton 'other' = a triton with no exact row anywhere (resolves '<cc>|*'; modelled with the tensor-descriptor API present). measured = the kit's pinned-stack triton on a card it has a config of record for, or a kit's own Blackwell sweep (triton-3.7 image). identical=false rows are the selections that change: either unmeasured, or a measured selection now served by a cell the core table names under 'successors' (the same output bytes on the tested matrix; tests/test_trimul_v4_one_table.py accepts exactly those).
